items.text: Let it be. Gavin came back and walked straight up to the old woman, typed `give spoon`, and got the refusal he should get — the spoon left his hands in the earlier trade. He's twenty seconds into a session, not stuck, not asking anyone anything; the intention I'd written down was about the door and he hasn't gone near it. No reason for a voice out of the air yet.
